tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje rgyal po la gtor ba 'bul ba ni/ rang yid dam du bsgom la/ oṃ swabha ba shud+dho haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nas mdun du song ba las me long gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar pad+ma dang zla ba dang glang po'i gdan la yi ge phu nag po gcig bsam/ de 'od du zhu ba las klu'i dge bsnyen chen po/ sku mdog nag la 'jig pa'i cha byad can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje'am nor bu/ g.yon pas dbugs kyi rkyal pa thogs/ zhal nas me lce dang dug gi kha rlang 'thul ba/ sku sbrul nag po'i zur phud lnga dang gdeng kha bdun gyi dbu la spras pa/ sbrul mgo re re la yang mig gsum gsum yod pa/ smad lto phye nag pos dkris pa/ yang bsgrub pa'am zhi ba'i dus thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba gzhon nu mdzes pa'i rnam par bsgom/ de'i thugs ka'i phu las 'od zer 'phros nas rgya mtsho'i nang nas klu chen po bran 'khor btsun mo sras 'khor dang pa na ga ra tsa sa ma ya dza dza/ ces pa bsam/ yang na lcag kyu'i phyag rgya bca' la/ oṃ na ga ra tsa badz+ra ra tsa sa ma ya a k+ṣar ya khug dza dza/ hūm̐ rgya mtsho chen po gting rum nas// klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyal bu// 'jog po mtha' yas stobs kyi rgyu// rigs ldan dung skyong hū lu dang*// dbyugs 'dzin bram ze pad+ma dang*// lha mo zla bas spyi gtsug dang*// dge bsnyen sras dang btsun mor bcas// rang rang gnas nas 'dir gshegs shig /ces pas spyan drangs la dam tshig pa la bstims la thugs kar yi ge mthar sngags 'phreng skor la bzlas pa bya/ rbad pa la sngags gshams la ༵ྖྒཻ bh+yo/ gsad pa la ma ra ya phaṭa gdag sod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman sna tshogs pa dang*/ rin po che bsres pa'i dkar gtor rgya chen po bshams la ba dmar ra kar 'o mas bran la steg gi khar bzhag la/ rang nyid stong par bsam pa'i ngang la/

oṃ swa bha wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho haṃ/ mdun du pad+ma'i steng du bh+ruṃ zhu ba las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mri ta hūm̐ phaṭa rdzas zhu ba las bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdang chags pa ro bcud dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ na ga ra tsā badz+ra ra tsa i dam bha ling ta kha kha kha hi ces bdun brjod la/ dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma la zugs nas gsol bas mnyes nas ci bcol pa'i las byed par bsam la// hūm̐ klu yul na bkra gseng sngo na// klu mkhar sngon pos nang gshed nas// klu rgyal gdol pa dbug len ni// sku mdog sngo nag khros pa'i gzugs// phyag g.yas rdo rje zhag pa bsnam// dam nyams dgra bo sdom la shog /g.yon pas nad kyi rkyal pa thogs// dam nyam dgra bo yul du thong*// dug sbrul nag pos gdeng ka can// dam nyam dgra la sbrul than thong*// zhal nas nad kyi rlangs pa 'thul// dam nyam dgra bo mdze nad thong/ dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ mthun pa'i gtor ma "$ 'di bzhes la// rims nad sna tshogs dgra la thong*// sngon gyi khas blang dran par gyis// nad rigs sna tshogs dgra la thong*// mdze nag rlung nag 'tshub 'tshub thong*// mdze skya me lce mched mched gyis// shu ba bu yug ltar du thong*// khyod sngar yang rang dam rang gi bcas// da yang dam la gnas par gyis// rgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la// khyod bu ltar pho nya las mkhan yin/ las rnams myur du grub par gyis/ ces gtor ma skyal lo// rin po che karma pa'i dam la btags pa'i chos skyongs las mkhan rdo rje rgyal po'i gtor ma sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rjes mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// dge'o//
